title: QUIC RFC 9000 ACK Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P3 requirement-home tests, supporting ACK frame codec and fuzz tests, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers focused ACK frame parser, formatter, ACK range math, packet-number-space, acknowledged-packet persistence, Version Negotiation and Retry exclusion, and ECN feedback proof for the listed S19P3 requirements.
expected_result: S19P3 requirement-home tests prove ACK and ACK_ECN type handling, varint field preservation and truncation rejection, ACK range count and descending range math, zero and maximum-value boundaries, ECN counter presence, validated ECN-CE congestion response, packet-number-space-qualified ACK processing, persistent acknowledgment state, and Version Negotiation/Retry exclusion.
procedure: Run the focused S19P3 requirement-home filter.
Run supporting ACK frame codec and frame-codec fuzz tests.
preconditions: Existing ACK parser and formatter remain the canonical ACK wire-format seam.
Existing ACK-generation state and sender flow controller remain the canonical ACK state and sender-ledger seams.
Existing packet parser remains the canonical packet-number-space classifier.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim closure of other S19 frame families, full ECN validation policy, public QUIC APIs, or packet-level close emission behavior for every malformed ACK frame.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The focused S19P3 filter passed 92/92, the combined S19P3 and ACK codec filter passed 98/98, and generated triage resolves all 37 S19P3/S19P3P1/S19P3P2 requirements as trace-clean.
